correctness.rationale: Fresh independently coded exact-state recurrence on four suffix-bit states and all 256 observed triple masks starts once from each two-bit word and appends both bits. For n=3..50, the 256 counts sum exactly to 2^n. It separately found at n=13: c(full)=934 versus two masks 0x7f,0xfe at 989; at n=14: full=2632 versus largest proper=2218; and strict full maximum every n=14..50. For n>=51, any missing triple e forces avoidance in t=floor(n/3) independent nonoverlapping triples, so each proper fiber <=2^n(7/8)^t, while full fiber >=2^n[1-8(7/8)^t]; strict since 9(7/8)^17=2093674625884863/2251799813685248<1. The 256-term inclusion-exclusion with four-state forbidden-edge matrices independently follows. Finite checks certify only specified finite range; tail is proven by exact rational bound.
